answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 33379 Country: India Title: I am 26 years old. I am a body builder. I want to remove my chest hair for good look of my body. Can I remove it or not? Question: I am 26 years old. I am a body builder. I want to remove my chest hair for good look of my body. Can I remove it or not? Answer ID: 33379 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1150/720/L=1432) You can remove the hair of chest, but it is not better to do so. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
